Three sure-thing first picks

If you only book one table, start here — the grandest room, the best sunset, and the most romantic dining room downtown.

Every card has the reason it works for a date and the dish to order. Mark each spot ✓ Been there or 🔖 Want to go to build your list, then filter by it with “My list” above. Your marks save on this device and stay put between visits.

Put Date Night on your Home Screen

On iPhone, this page works as its own app — full-screen, with your coupes photo as the icon:

  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button.
  3. Tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.

Your Been there / Want to go marks and hearts save in this browser on this phone — they live here, not in the Muse copy, so the two lists won't sync.

Good to know: Hours, menus and prices change — check the restaurant's site or call before you go. Reservations are recommended for most of these spots, especially on weekends; Pier W is best timed to sunset, and Marble Room, DANTE and Cru Uncorked book out furthest ahead.

Sources: Cleveland Magazine, “Most Romantic Restaurants” (Feb 2026), plus top-rated fine-dining listings — details checked Nov 5, 2026. Ratings shown where a source rating was verified. Photos: a real photo of each restaurant — its dining room, storefront, or defining view — from the restaurant's own site, Cleveland Magazine, or its verified listings; Cleveland skyline via Aerial Agents.
